About Apartman Karolina

Featuring a balcony with city views, a terrace and a bar, Apartment Karolina can be found in Rijeka, close to The Maritime and History Museum of the Croatian Littoral and 1.7 km from The Croatian National Theatre Ivan pl. Zajc. The property features sea views and free WiFi throughout the property.

A children's playground is available for guests at Apartment Karolina. Trsat Castle is 5.3 km from Apartment Karolina, while HNK Rijeka Rujevica Stadium is 5.8 km from the property.
